1:5: D Kečč ay naɛbed, d Kečč ay neţţer d Amɛiwen;
1:7: Abrid n wid i Tɣateḍ; ur n wid i K isserfayen, neɣ n imɣeṛṛqen.
2:2: Aţţan Tezmamt, ur degs ccekk, d nnhaya i wid iţḥezziben;
2:3: wid iumnen s tbaḍnit, iţẓallan, iţseddiqen seg wayen iten Nɣat;
2:4: wid iumnen s wayen i k d irsen, akked wayen id irsen, uqbel ik, u, ɣef laxeṛt, nitni, ţţutebbten.
2:5: Widak, di nnhaya n Mass nnsen, widak, d isaɛdiyen.
2:6: Wid ijehlen, s tideţ, iɛuḍa fellasen ma tnubaḍ ten, neɣ ur ten tnubaḍ. Ur ţţamnen.
2:7: Isleɣ Ṛebbi ulawen nnsen, akked imeẓẓuɣen nnsen. Irs leɣyaṛ ɣef allen nnsen. Fellasen aɛaqeb abarar.
2:8: Ger yimdanen, llan wid iqqaṛen: "numen s Ṛebbi akked wass aneggaru”; nitni, ur llin d lmumnin.
2:9: La xedɛen Ṛebbi akked wid iumnen. Ur xedɛen siwa iman nnsen, ur faqen.
2:10: Aṭan deg ulawen nnsen; Irna yasen Ṛebbi aṭan. Fellasen aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan, ilmend n wayen skiddiben.
2:11: Ma nnan asen: "ur ssefsadet di tmurt"! A d inin: "nekwni d wid, kan, iţleqqimen".
2:12: Day mačči d nitni, s tideţ, ay d ifessaden, maca ur faqen?
2:13: Ma nnan asen: "amnet, akken umnen medden"! A d inin: "day a namen, akken umnen ijeɣlufen"? Day mačči d nitni, s tideţ, ay d ijeɣlufen, maca ur ẓṛin.
2:14: Ma mmugren d wid iumnen, ad inin: "numen". Mara yilin weḥḥedsen, ar ccwaṭen nnsen, ad inin: "nekwni yidwen! Nekwni la nettihi kan".
2:15: Ṛebbi ad Ittihi fellasen. Isnerna yasen lbweɣḍ nnsen; ddebdeben.
2:16: Widak, d wid iuɣen ttelfan s nnhaya; ur d issasay ssuq nnsen, ur ţwanhan.
2:17: Teḍṛa yidsen am win issaɣen times. Mi tnewweṛ ayen i s d izzin, Ṛebbi Iddem tafat nnsen, Iooa ten di tillas, ur ţwalin.
2:18: Ɛaẓgen, gugmen, dreɣlen; ihi, nitni ur d ţţuɣalen s abrid.
2:19: Neɣ am usigna igenni, degs tillas, tirmegt, lebṛaq. Pţarran iḍudan nnsen deg imeẓẓuɣen nnsen, mgal ssiɛqat; ad nnestaṛen si tmeţţant. Ṛebbi Izzi i ijehliyen.
2:20: Qṛib i sen iḥwi lebṛaq, iẓṛi. Yal tikelt ideg i sen icɛal, ad ddun syis. Mi sen ixsi, ad ḥebsen. Ma ihwa yaS i Ṛebbi, ad asen Ikkes timesliwt akked yiẓṛi nnsen. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Izmer i yal cci.
2:21: A yimdanen! Ɛabdet Mass nnwen ikwen Ixelqen, kunwi, akked wid i kwen id izwaren, amar a ţḥezzbem;
2:22: i wen Irran tamurt d usu, igenni d lebni; id Isseɣli d aman seg igenni, Issuffeɣ ed yissen ţţemṛa, d ṛṛeẓq i kunwi. Ihi, ur ţţarrat tanudda i Ṛebbi, u kunwi teẓṛam.
2:23: Ma tellam di ccekk, ɣef wayen id Nessers ar umdan nneɣ, awit ed tasuṛeţ i ţ icban. Neccdet ed inagan nnwen, war Ṛebbi, ma tessawalem tideţ.
2:24: Ma ur tessawḍem, u, war ccekk, ur tessawaḍem, ḥezzbet i tmes isseṛɣan imdanen, idɣaɣen, iţţuheggan i ijehliyen.
2:25: Becceṛ wid iumnen, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, ar i nitni, leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ţţazzalen. Yal tikelt ara ţţuṛeẓqen, si ţţemṛa nnsen, ad inin: "d aya is neţţuṛeẓq, uqbel". Iţţunefk asen i ten icban. Din, jjwao nnsen d ayen iṣfan. Degsen ad wekkṛen.
2:26: Ih, ur Ikukra ara Ṛebbi, a d Ifk amedya n tiziţ, neɣ iţ iɣelben. Wid iumnen ẓṛan neţţa d tideţ, sɣuṛ Mass nnsen. Wanag wid ijehlen qqaṛen: "acu Ibɣa Ṛebbi s umedya agi"? Yis, Itellif aṭas; yis, Inehhu aṭas. Ur Itellif yis, siwa iballaɣen;
2:27: wid iţṛuẓun lemɛahda n Ṛebbi, deffir lmitaq iS, issemfaṛaqen ayen id Iumeṛ Ṛebbi ad imlil, issefsaden di tmurt. Widak d imexsuṛen.
2:28: Amek ara tnekṛem Ṛebbi? Tellam temmuten, Issader kwen id. Sinna, a kwen Ineɣ, sinna, a kwen id Issider, sinna, ɣuṛeS a ţţuɣalem.
2:29: D Neţţa i wen Ixelqen ayen akw illan di tmurt; sinna, Izzi ar igenni, Iwqem it d ṣa igenwan. Neţţa, Issen yal cci.
2:30: Mi Inna Mass ik, i lmalayek: "Nek ad Rreɣ aneṣṣaf di tmurt". Nnant aS: "day a Pţerreḍ, degs, win ara isfesden degs, ara izzizlen idamen? Wanag, nekwenti nesbuccuɛ K s ccekṛan, u Neṛṛequ yaK". Inna: "Nek, Ẓṛiɣ ayen ur teẓṛimt".
2:31: Isseḥfeḍ akw ismawen i Adem. Sinna, Issken iten i lmalayek, Inna: "efkemt iyI d ismawen n wigi, ma kunemti d sut tideţ".
2:32: Nnant: "gedha s yisseK! Ur nessin, siwa i aɣ Teslemdeḍ. Kečč, s tideţ, d Amusnaw, d Bab n ṣṣwab".
2:33: Inna: "a Adem, efk asent ismawen nnsen". Mi sent imla ismawen nnsen, Inna: "day ur a kwent Nniɣ ara: Nek Ssneɣ tabaḍnit n tmurt akked igenwan, u Ẓṛiɣ ayen d teqqaṛem, akked wayen teţţeffrem"?
2:34: Mi Nenna i lmalayek: "knumt i Adem"! Knant, siwa Iblis. Iugi, u ismeɣweṛ iman is. Illa seg ijehliyen.
2:35: Nenna: "a Adem, ezdeɣ kečč akked tmeṭṭut ik, di Loennet, eččet segs, s tawant, ayen i wen ihwan. Ur ţţaẓet ar ttejṛa yagi, mulac a ţţilim d imednas".
2:36: Ikellex iten Cciṭan fellas. Issuffeɣ iten id seg wanda llan. Nenna: "ṣṣubbet, d icenga bbwaygarawen. I kunwi, di tmurt, iɣimi akked zzhu, siwa tallit".
2:37: Adem iṭṭef awalen n Mass is. Issuref as. Neţţa, s tideţ, Issuruf, Iţḥunu.
2:38: Nenna: "ṣṣubbet segs, akken ma tellam. War ccekk, a kwen id tas nnhaya sɣuṛI". Wid iddan d nnhaya, ur ţţagwaden, ur ɣweblen.
2:39: Wid ijehlen u skaddben issekniyen nneɣ, widak d at tmes, degs ad wekkṛen.
2:40: A yAt Isṛail! Mmektit ed lɣit iW, is ikwen Ṛeẓqeɣ. Eṭṭfet di lemɛahda W, ad Ṭṭfeɣ di lemɛahda nnwen. D nek iwumi ara tḥezzbem.
2:41: Amnet s wayen id Sserseɣ, itebbten ayen illan ɣuṛwen. Ur ţţilit d imezwura ara t iagwin. Ur ţţaɣet, s issekniyen iW, ayen ṛxisen. D nek iwumi ara tḥezzbem.
2:42: Ur slusut, i tideţ, tikerkas. Ur teffret tideţ, u kunwi teẓṛam.
2:44: Day a ţţamṛem iseɣ i medden, a ţţeţţum iman nnwen? U kunwi teqqaṛem Tazmamt. Day ur tefhimem ara?
2:45: Ssutret lemɛawna n ṣṣbeṛ akked tẓallit. Ih, dayen iwaɛṛen, siwa i imeẓluḍen,
2:46: wid iḥṣan ar ad mlilen akked Mass nnsen, u ɣuṛeS, nitni, war ccekk, ad uɣalen.
2:47: A yAt Isṛail! Mmektit ed lɣit iW, is ikwen Ṛeẓqeɣ. Nek, Smenyafeɣ kwen i imaḍalen.
2:48: Ḥezzbet i wass ideg ur iţţuoazi yiwen deg umkan n wayeḍ, s wacemma. Ur teţwaqbal ccafuɛa segs, ur teţwaṭṭaf, segs, leɣṛama, ur ten ţţaɛwanen.
2:49: Mi kwen Nsellek seg ugdud n Ferɛun, sɛaddayen fellawen aɛaqeb adiran. Zellun arrac nnwen, ssidiren tilawin nnwen. Ayagi d taluft tabarart, sɣuṛ Mass nnwen.
2:50: Mi, yiswen, Nessemfaṛeq ill, Nsellek ikwen, Neɣmeq agdud n Ferɛun, kunwi la teţwalim.
2:51: Mi Nga lemɛahda i Musa, kuẓet waḍan; sinna, deffir es, teddam d uɛajmi. Kunwi d imednas.
2:52: Sinna, deffir waya, Nsemmeḥ awen, amar a ţţesnemmrem.
2:53: Mi Nefka, i Musa, Tazmamt akked ufraz, amar a ţţeţţwanhum.
2:54: Mi inna Musa i ugdud is: "a yagdud iw! Kunwi, s tideţ, tdensem iman nnwen, mi teddam d uɛajmi. Ssutret ssmaḥ i Uxellaq nnwen; mminɣet, ţţif i kunwi ar Uxellaq nnwen. Issuref awen. Neţţa, s tideţ, Issuruf, Iţḥunu".
2:55: Mi tennam: "a Musa! Ur neţţamen yisek, d awezɣi, alamma nwala Ṛebbi, ɛinani". Tewwet ikwen id ssiɛqa, kunwi teţwalim.
2:56: Sinna, Nerra kwen id, deffir tmeţţant nnwen, amar a ţţesnemmrem.
2:57: S usigna, Nerra yawen tili. Nessers awen d lmenna, ifeṛṛuoen: "eččet si tẓidanin is ikwen Nɣat". Ur aɣ dnisen, maca densen iman nnsen.
2:58: Mi Nenna: "kecmet tamdint agi, eččet degs, s tawant, ayen i wen ihwan; kecmet si tebburt, s lekni; init: nendem. Ad awen Nsemmeḥ tuccḍa nnwen, a Nernu i iɛaṛḍiyen".
2:59: Wid idensen bedlen awal, ur d win i sen nnan. Nessers ed, i wid idensen, tawaɣit seg igenni, ilmend n tucmitin nnsen.
2:60: Mi issuter Musa aman i ugdud is, Nenna: "ewwet aẓṛu, s uɛkkwaz ik". Feggḍent ed, segs, mrawsnat tliwa. Yal wa iẓṛa anda ara issew. "Eččet, esswet, si ṛṛeẓq n Ṛebbi. Ur ssefsadet di tmurt am imjaḥen".
2:61: Mi tennam: "a Musa! Ur nesteqnaɛ biţţa s yiwen n lqut. Nuj aɣ Mass ik, ad aɣ d Issuffeɣ ayen d teggar tmurt: tizzegzewt is, axyaṛ is, ticcert is, laɛds is, lebṣel is". Inna: "tebɣam a ţbedlem ayen ilhan s wayen ixuṣen? Ṣṣubbet ar Maṣeṛ, a n tafem, war ccekk, ayen tessutrem". Iɣli d fellasen ddell akked ẓẓelt. Sebbeben d urrif n Ṛebbi. Ayagi, acku llan ugin issekniyen n Ṛebbi, neqqen lambiyya, war ssebba. Ayagi, imi ɛuṣan, u zgaren tilas.
2:62: Ih, wid iumnen, udayen, imasiḥiyen, iṣabiyen, kra iumnen s Ṛebbi akked wass aneggaru, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, ad sɛun arraz ar Mass nnsen, ur ţţagwaden, ur ɣweblen.
2:63: Mi Nga laɛqed yidwen, Nessuli adrar sennig wen: "eṭṭfet nezzeh ayen i wen Nefka, mmektit ed i illan degs, amar a ţḥezzbem".
2:64: Sinna, deffir waya, twexxṛem. Lemmer mačči d lfeḍl n Ṛebbi fellawen, akked uḥunu S, a ţţilim seg imexsuṛen.
2:65: Niɣ tessnem wid, segwen, iccḍen di Ssebt. Nenna yasen: "ilit d iddawen imaɛfan"!
2:66: Nerra ţ d amedya i imuddiren akked wid i ten id ineṣfen, u d aɛggen i wid iţḥezziben.
2:67: Mi inna Musa i ugdud is: "Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iumeṛ awen d a ţţezlum tafunast". Nnan: "day a tettihiḍ fellaɣ"? Inna: "ad iyi Isseṛ Ṛebbi! Ur ţţiliɣ seg at war tussna".
2:68: Nnan: "nuj aɣ ar Mass ik, ad aɣ d Ibeggen anta ţ". Inna: "Neţţa, s tideţ, la Iqqaṛ: tafunast ur wessret, ur meẓẓiyet, garasen. Xedmet i wen d iţţumṛen".
2:69: Nnan: "nuj ar Mass ik, ad aɣ d Ibeggen ini s". Inna: "Neţţa, s tideţ, la Iqqaṛ: d tafunast tawṛaɣt, ini imfeooeo, ad iaɛoeb w iţ iwalan".
2:70: Nnan: "nuj ar Mass ik, ad aɣ d Ibeggen anta ţ. ɣuṛneɣ, s tideţ, tistan ţţemcabint. Ih, ma Ibɣa Ṛebbi, a neţwanhu".
2:71: Inna: "Neţţa, s tideţ, la Iqqaṛ: d tafunast ur taɛtib si tyerza n tmurt, neɣ si tissit n yigran, tṣeḥḥa, ur teţwacṛeḍ". Nnan as: "tura, tebbwiḍ d tideţ". Zlan ţ. Qṛib ur ewqimen.
2:72: Mi tenɣam yiwen, wa irra ţ id ɣef wa. Ṛebbi Issuffeɣ ed ayen teţţeffrem.
2:73: Nenna: "ewwtet eţ s kra ines". Akka i Issidir Ṛebbi lmeggtin. Issenɛat awen issekniyen iS, amar a ţfehmem.
2:74: Sinna, deffir waya, qquṛen wulawen nnwen; cuban aẓṛu, neɣ kteṛ, di taɣeṛt. Ih, llan iẓṛa iseg d ţfeggiḍen isaffen. Llan, s tideţ, wid iţceqqiqen, teffɣen d waman segsen. S tideţ, llan wid iɣellin si tugwdi n Ṛebbi. Ur Iɣfil Ṛebbi ɣef wayen txeddmem.
2:75: Day tṛeɣbem a kwen amnen? Niɣ arbaɛ, segsen, ssemḥasen i wawal n Ṛebbi, sinna, mi t fehmen, ad as bedlen udem, u nitni ẓṛan.
2:76: Mi mmugren wid iumnen, ad inin: "numen". Mi qqimen garasen, qqaṛen: "day ad asen tinim ayen i wen Imla Ṛebbi, a kwen nnaɣen yis, ar Mass nnwen? Day ur teţmeyyizem ara"?
2:77: Neɣ ur ẓṛin ara, Ṛebbi Issen ayen teffren, akked wayen qqaṛen.
2:78: Garasen, at war taɣuṛi, ur nessin Tazmamt, siwa ayen nnwan. Nitni ɣilen kan.
2:79: A tawaɣit n wid iţţarun Tazmamt s ifassen nnsen, sinna, qqaṛen: "ayagi sɣuṛ Ṛebbi", iwakken ad aɣen, yis, ayen ṛxisen! A tawaɣit nnsen, ilmend n wayen uran ifassen nnsen! A tawaɣit nnsen, ɣef wayen keţţben!
2:80: Nnan: "ur aɣ teţnal tmes, d awezɣi, siwa kra n wussan". Ini: "day teṭṭfem lemɛahda sɣuṛ Ṛebbi? Ṛebbi, d awezɣi, ur Izeggil lemɛahda S. Neɣ teqqaṛem, ɣef Ṛebbi, ayen ur tessinem"?
2:81: Xaṭi, win ikesben tucmiţ, u tenneḍ as tuccḍa s…, widak, d at tmes, degs ad wekkṛen.
2:82: Wid iumnen, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, widak, d at Loennet, degs ad wekkṛen.
2:83: Mi Nga laɛqed i At Isṛail: "ur ɛabdet siwa Ṛebbi. Elhut ar imawlan, ar llzem nnwen, ar igujilen, ar igellilen. Init i medden, awal imaɛnen. ẒẓẒallet, zekkit". Sinna, twexxṛem, siwa kra segwen, u, kunwi, tnumrem.
2:84: Mi wen Nga laɛqed nnwen: "ur zzazalet idim nnwen, ur ţemssuffuɣet seg ixxamen nnwen". Dɣa twefqem, kunwi d inagan.
2:85: Sinna, kunwi d wid imminɣen, tessuffɣem arbaɛ segwen, seg ixxamen nnsen. Tezzim asen s ibekkaḍen akked taɛdawt. Ma usan kwen id, d imeḥbas, tfeddum ten. Irna, iţwagdel awen usuffeɣ nnsen. Day tumnem deg uḥric n Tezmamt, tnekṛem wayeḍ? Anwa ay d arraz n wid, segwen, ixedmen aya, ma mačči d ddell, di tmeddurt n ddunit, u, ass n tnekra, ad ţţunefken i uɛaqeb uqsiḥ maḍi? Ur Iɣfil Ṛebbi ɣef wayen txeddmem.
2:86: Widak d wid iuɣen tudert n ddunit s laxeṛt, ur iţţifsus fellasen uɛaqeb, ur ţţusellken.
2:87: Niɣ Nefka Tazmamt i Musa. Nuzen ed imazanen, deffir es. Nefka abeggen i Ɛisa, mmi s n Meryem, Null it s ṛṛuḥ iqedsen. Yal tikelt ideg ara kwen id ias umazan, s wayen ur awen nehwi, tesmeɣwṛem iman nnwen. Kra teskaddbem ten, kra tenɣam ten.
2:88: Nnan: "ulawen nneɣ qquṛen". Xaṭi, Ixza ten Ṛebbi, ilmend n tijehli nnsen. Drus iten wid iumnen.
2:89: Mi ten id tusa Tezmamt, sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, d atebbet n wayen illan ɣuṛsen, - u llan, iuɣ lḥal, ssuturen ad ɣelben wid ijehlen - mi ten id iusa wayen ssnen, ugin t. Ad Inɛal Ṛebbi ijehliyen!
2:90: I icmet wayen iɣef zzenzen iman nnsen! Ugin ayen id Issers Ṛebbi. Ḥesden mi id Issers Ṛebbi, si lfeḍl iS, i win i S ihwan n yimdanen iS. Sebbeben urrif ar wayeḍ. I ijehliyen, aɛaqeb isdullun.
2:91: Ma nnan asen: "amnet s wayen id Issers Ṛebbi"! A d inin: "numen s wayen id irsen ɣuṛneɣ". Nekṛen ayen i t id itebɛan, u neţţa d tideţ, d atebbet n wayen illan ɣuṛsen. Ini: "acimi tneqqem lambiyya n Ṛebbi, zik, ma d lmumnin ay tellam"?
2:92: Niɣ iusa kwen id Musa, s ubeggen. Sinna, deffir es, teddam akked uɛajmi. Kunwi d imednas.
2:93: Mi Nga laɛqed yidwen, Nessuli adrar sennig wen: "eṭṭfet nezzeh ayen i wen Nefka, u ssemḥesset". Nnan d: "nesla u nɛuṣa". Ikecm asen uɛajmi ar wul, si tjehli nnsen. Ini: "dir it wayen i wen iumeṛ liman nnwen, ma d lmumnin ay tellam".
2:94: Ini: "maday, ar Ṛebbi, axxam aneggaru i kunwi kan, ur ţkkan ara imdanen, mennit tameţţant, ma tessawalem tideţ"!
2:95: D awezɣi, ur ţ ţmennin, ilmend n wayen xedmen ifassen nnsen. Ṛebbi Issen imednas.
2:96: A ten tafeḍ, war ccekk, ḥemmlen tameddurt sennig medden, sennig imcurak. Atan yiwen segsen, issaram ad idder agim iseggwasen. Teɣwzi n laɛmeṛ is, ur as tessifrir aɛaqeb. Ṛebbi Iţwali ayen xeddmen.
2:97: Ini: "anwa illan d acengu n Jebrayen"? D neţţa, s tideţ, it id issersen ɣef wul ik, s lebɣi n Ṛebbi. D atebbet n wayen it id izwaren, d nnhaya u d abecceṛ n lmumnin.
2:98: Win illan d acengu n Ṛebbi, lmalayek iS, imazanen iS, Jebrayen, Mikail…, ihi, Ṛebbi d acengu ijehliyen.
2:99: Niɣ Nessers ak d issekniyen iberrzen. I ten inekṛen, siwa iballaɣen.
2:100: Day yal tikelt ideg ara gen laɛqed, a t ixdaɛ urbaɛ segsen? Ih, tegwti segsen, ur uminen.
2:101: Mi ten id iusa umazan sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, itebbet ayen illan ɣuṛsen, arbaɛ n wid iwumi teţţunefk Tezmamt, rran Tazmamt n Ṛebbi s azagur nnsen, amzun ur ssinen.
2:102: Ddan akked wayen xedmen ccwaṭen mgal tagelda n Sliman. Sliman ur ijhil. Maca ccwaṭen jehlen. Sseḥfaḍen i medden ssḥur, akked wayen id irsen, di Babil, ar lmalayek Harut akked Marut. Ur sselmaden yiwen, mebla ma nnan: "nekwni nɣewwu kan, ur jehhel"! Ḥefḍen, ɣuṛsen, amek ara ssemfaṛaqen argaz akked tmeṭṭut is. Ur ṭṭurun yiwen syis, siwa ma Ibɣa Ṛebbi. Ḥefḍen ara ten iḍuṛṛen, ur ten ineffaɛ. Niɣ ẓṛan ar win i ţ iuɣen, ur as illi umur di laxeṛt. War ccekk, ard ucmit wayen is zzenzen leṛwaḥ nnsen, lemmer ẓṛin!
2:103: Lemmer, s tideţ, uminen u ḥezzben, ad ifrir warraz sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, lemmer ssinen.
2:104: A wid iumnen! Ur qqaret: "Ɛass aɣ d", init: "Wali aɣ d", u ssemḥesset. I ijehliyen, aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
2:105: Ur bɣin ara ijehliyen, seg wid iwumi teţţunefk Tezmamt, akked imcurak, ad awen d irs kra n lxiṛ, sɣuṛ Mass nnwen. Ṛebbi Ismenyaf, s uḥunu S, win i S ihwan. Ṛebbi d Bab n lfeḍl ameqwṛaḥan.
2:106: Ur Nessemsay assekni, neɣ ur t Nesseţţu, mebla ma Nebbwi d win it yifen, neɣ i t icban. Day ur teẓṛiḍ ara Ṛebbi Izmer i yal cci?
2:107: Day ur teẓṛiḍ ara, ar n Ṛebbi tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan? Ur tesɛim, war Ṛebbi, bab, neɣ asettaṛ.
2:108: Neɣ tebɣam a ţţesteqsim Amazan nnwen, akken iţţusteqsa, zik, Musa? Win ibeddlen liman s tijehli, innetlaf ar yir abrid.
2:109: Si leḥsed nnsen, aṭas seg wAt Tezmamt, mi sen d tban tideţ, budden awen tijehli, mbaɛd liman nnwen. Ssemḥet, ssemsut, ar d Ias Ṛebbi s lameṛ iS. Niɣ Ṛebbi Izmer i yal cci.
2:110: Ẓẓallet, zekkit. Ayen ara tezzewrem n lxiṛ i iman nnwen, a t tafem ar Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iţwali ayen akw txeddmem.
2:111: Nnan: "ur ikeččem Loennet, siwa win illan d uday, neɣ d amasiḥi". D wagi ay d asirem nnsen. Ini: "awit ed atebbet nnwen, ma tessawalem tideţ".
2:112: Xaṭi, win iunzen i Ṛebbi, u d aɛṛḍi, ad isɛu arraz is, ar Mass is. Ur ţţagwaden, ur ɣweblen.
2:113: Nnan wudayen: "imasiḥiyen ur sennden s acemma". Nnan imasiḥiyen: "udayen ur sennden s acemma". U nitni la qqaṛen Tazmamt. Akka, wid ur nessin ara, nnan am nitni. Ad Iḥudd Ṛebbi, garasen, ass n tnekra, ɣef wayen iɣef mgarraden.
2:114: Anwa idensen sennig wid igedlen, di leowamaɛ n Ṛebbi, asmekti n yisem iS, u lhan d deg ussexṛeb nnsen? Widak, ur iwata ara a ten kecmen, siwa ma s tugwdi. I nitni, ddell di ddunit, u aɛaqeb abarar di laxeṛt.
2:115: N Ṛebbi agmuḍ akked utaram. Ar wanda tezzim, din Udem n Ṛebbi. Ih, Ṛebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.
2:116: Nnan: "Ṛebbi Isɛa mmi S". Gedha s yiS! Niɣ ineS i illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Akw, ţẓallan i Neţţa,
2:117: Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan. Ma Iseyya lameṛ, ad as Yini kan: "ili"! Ad yili.
2:118: Nnan wid ur nessin: "a lemmer ad aɣ d Immeslay Ṛebbi, neɣ ad aɣ d ias ussekni"! Akka ay nnan wid i ten id izwaren, am awalen nnsen. Pţemcabin wulawen nnsen. Niɣ Nbeggen ed issekniyen i ugdud iţţutebbten.
2:119: Ih, Nuzen ik id, s tideţ, d abcir, u d aneddaṛ. Ur iţţili fellak usteqsi ɣef at wuɣud.
2:120: Ur k ţṛaḍin wudayen neɣ imasiḥiyen, alamma teddiḍ d ddin nnsen. Ini: "d nehhu n Ṛebbi ay d nehhu". Ma teddiḍ akked usirem nnsen, deffir wayen ik ed iusan n tmusni, ur k iţfukku, si Ṛebbi, bab, neɣ asettaṛ.
2:121: Wid iwumi Nefka Tazmamt, qqaṛen ţ leqṛaya iwatan. Widak umnen yis. Wid i ţ iugin, widak d imexsuṛen.
2:122: A yAt Isṛail! Mmektit ed lɣit iW, is i kwen ɣateɣ. Nek, Smenyafeɣ kwen i imaḍalen.
2:123: Ḥezzbet i wass ideg ur iţţuqeṭṭi yiwen, deg umkan n wayeḍ, s wacemma; ur teţwaqbal leɣṛama segs, ur t tenfaɛ ccafuɛa, ur ţţusellken.
2:124: Ibṛahim, mi t Ijeṛṛeb Mass is, s wawalen, iuɣ awal. Inna: "Nek, a k Rreɣ d win ara inehhun medden". Inna: "u si tarwa w"? Inna: "lemɛahda W ur taɛna ara imednas".
2:125: Mi Nerra Axxam d lemqam i yimdanen, u d amkan n laman: "erret lemqam n Ibṛahim d loamaɛ"! Nɛuhed i Ibṛahim akked Ismaɛil: "zzizdget Axxam iW, i wid idewwiṛen, wid iţɣimin, wid iṭṭinizen, wid ikennun".
2:126: Mi inna Ibṛahim: "a Mass iw! Err wagi d tamdint n laman, ɣit imezdaɣ is s ţţemṛat; wid, segsen, iumnen s Ṛebbi akked wass aneggaru". Inna: "win ijehlen, a t Ooeɣ ad izhu cwiṭ, sinna, a t Nehṛeɣ ar uɛaqeb n tmes. A tuɣalin tucmiţ"!
2:127: Ibṛahim akked Ismaɛil, mi ssalayen leḥyuḍ n Uxxam: "a Mass nneɣ! Eqbel sɣuṛneɣ, Kečč, s tideţ, d Win Isellen, d Amusnaw.
2:128: A Mass nneɣ! Err aneɣ d imḍuɛen iK, u, si dderya nneɣ, lois ar aK ianzen. Mel aɣ isekkiren nneɣ, Ssuref aɣ. Kečč, s tideţ, Tessurufeḍ, Teţḥunuḍ.
2:129: A Mass nneɣ! Azen asen d amazan segsen, ad asen iqqaṛ issekniyen iK, ad asen isseḥfeḍ Tazmamt akked ṣṣwab, a ten izzizdeg. Kečč, s tideţ, d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab".
2:130: Anwa iugin ddin n Ibṛahim, siwa win iccemten iman is? Niɣ Nefren it di ddunit. Di laxeṛt, neţţa, war ccekk, seg iɛaṛḍiyen.
2:131: Mi s Inna Mass is: "anez"! Inna: "unzeɣ aS i Mass imaḍalen".
2:132: Iweṣṣa yis Ibṛahim arraw is - akken Iaɛqub -: "a yarraw iw, Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Ifren awen ddin, ur ţţemmtet siwa ma tunzem".
2:133: Neɣ tellam d inagan mi d ters tmeţţant ar Yaɛqub, mi inna i tarwa s: "anwa ara tɛabdem deffir i"? Nnan: "a naɛbed Ṛebbi k, u Ṛebbi n lejdud ik: Ibṛahim, Ismaɛil, Isḥaq. Ṛebbi Yiwen. Nekwni nunez aS".
2:134: Wigi d lois i iɛaddan. Ines ayen ikseb, nnwen ayen tkesbem. Ur kwen steqsayen ɣef wayen xeddmen.
2:135: Nnan: "ilit d udayen neɣ d imasiḥiyen, a ţţeţwanhum". Ini: "Xaṭi, maca ddin n Ibṛahim, imalen ar tideţ. Ur illi seg imcurak".
2:136: Init: "numen s Ṛebbi akked wayen id irsen ɣuṛneɣ, wayen id irsen ar Ibṛahim, Ismaɛil, Isḥaq, Iaɛqub, laɛṛac, ayen iţţunefken i Musa, Ɛisa, ayen iţţunefken i lambiyya, sɣuṛ Mass nnsen. Ur nessemgarrad yiwen segsen, nekwni nunez aS".
2:137: Ma umnen ayen icuban ayen tumnem, atnan ţwanhan. Ma wexxṛen, haaten kan di lefṛaq. Iqadd ik Ṛebbi, segsen. Neţţa Issel, d Amusnaw.
2:138: Ssbiɣa, n Ṛebbi. Anwa yifen Ṛebbi i ssbiɣa? Nekwni d iɛabbaden iS.
2:139: Ini: "day ad aɣ tnamrem ɣef Ṛebbi, u Neţţa d Mass nneɣ, u d Mass nnwen? I nekwni igiten nneɣ, i kunwi igiten nnwen. Nekwni d izedganen iS".
2:140: Neɣ a d tinim: "s tideţ, Ibṛahim, Ismaɛil, Isḥaq, Iaɛqub, laɛṛac, llan d udayen, neɣ d imasiḥiyen"? Ini: "Anwa i isnen sennig akw, d kunwi neɣ d Ṛebbi"? Anwa i idensen sennig win iffren ccada, i isɛa sɣuṛ Ṛebbi? Ur Iɣfil Ṛebbi ɣef wayen txeddmem.
2:141: Asatu agi iɛadda. Ines ayen ikseb, nnwen ayen tkesbem. Ur fellawen asteqsi ɣef wayen xeddmen.
